### 2. Naming Conventions (BEM Pattern Confirmed)

The project uses **strict BEM pattern** with prefix `no-`:

**Existing Button Classes:**
- `.no-text-button` — Simple text-only button
- `.no-corner-btn` — Main button class with corner brackets
  - Modifiers: `--icon-before`, `--icon-only`, `--panel`, `--highlight`, `--icon-rotate`
  - Elements: `__text`, `__icon`, `__corner`
- `.no-corner-btn-wrap` — Wrapper container
- `.no-magnetic-corner-btn` — Variant with magnetic effect
- `.no-btn-bracket` — Bracket-only button (used in lists/sections)
  - Elements: `__cap`, `__text`
- `.no-prev-button` — Previous/navigation button
- `.shiny-cta` — CTA button with gradient shining effect (lines 31-189 in _button.scss)

**Pattern for new `no-btn-char` class:**
- Base: `.no-btn-char`
- Modifiers: `.no-btn-char--highlight`, `.no-btn-char--shimmer`, `.no-btn-char--shine`
- Elements: `.no-btn-char__text`, `.no-btn-char__char` (if needed)

### 3. Existing Shimmer/Shine Patterns

The codebase has TWO existing shimmering patterns to reference:

**A) `.shiny-cta` in `_button.scss` (lines 31-189)**
- Uses CSS @property for animated gradients
- Properties: `--gradient-angle`, `--gradient-angle-offset`, `--gradient-percent`, `--gradient-shine`
- Animations: `gradient-angle` (360deg rotation), `shimmer` (360deg rotate), `breathe` (scale breathing)
- Duration: 3s base animation with paused secondary layer
- Triggered on `:hover` and `:focus-visible`
- Has `prefers-reduced-motion` media query handling (line 444)

**B) `.no-corner-bracket--shine` in `_corner-bracket.scss` (lines 7-22, 81-83)**
- Uses `corner-bracket-glow` keyframe animation
- Filter-based approach: `drop-shadow()` with `color-mix()` and currentColor
- Duration: 2.5s ease-in-out infinite
- Dual shadow layers: inner glow (45%/55%) + outer spread (25%/35%)
- Minimal, elegant approach using filter property

### 4. Search Results: Existing `.no-btn` Usage

Only two files use `.no-btn-bracket` (not `.no-btn`):
- **`/c/Users/edn_y/renew_nineonelabs/resource/scss/components/_button.scss`** — Definition (lines 477-504)
- **`/c/Users/edn_y/renew_nineonelabs/resource/scss/pages/_sub.scss`** — Usage in 4 locations:
  - Lines 879, 912: Inside hover states for list items
  - Line 929: Inside `.no-btn-bracket { justify-content: flex-end; }`
  - Line 1042: Standalone margin adjustment

### 5. Available Variables & Mixins

**Transition & Animation Variables** (from `base/_root.scss`):
```scss

--duration-fast: 0.2s;
--duration-default: 0.4s;      /* Standard use */

--ease-out: cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.58, 1);
--ease-in-out: cubic-bezier(0.42, 0, 0.58, 1);
--ease-spring: cubic-bezier(0.175, 0.885, 0.32, 1.275);

--transition-default: var(--duration-default) var(--ease-default);
--transition-slow: var(--duration-slow) var(--ease-smooth);
```

### 6. CSS Cascade Layers Architecture

From `style.scss` (lines 13-23):
```
Priority (low → high):
reset < base < layout < components < pages < utilities < state
```

**New `.no-btn-char` styles MUST go in:**
- **File:** `/c/Users/edn_y/renew_nineonelabs/resource/scss/components/_button.scss`
- **Layer:** `@layer components` (already applied via `@include meta.load-css("components/button")`)
- **Location:** After existing button classes, before end of file

### 7. Import Architecture

`style.scss` (line 53) loads `_button.scss` in the `@layer components` block:
```scss
@layer components {
  @include meta.load-css("components/button");
  /* NO MANUAL IMPORT NEEDED — uses meta.load-css() */
}
```

**No additional imports required** — any new `.no-btn-char` rules added to `_button.scss` will auto-compile.

### 8. Recommended Location for `no-btn-char` Styles

**File:** `/c/Users/edn_y/renew_nineonelabs/resource/scss/components/_button.scss`

**Position:** After `.no-prev-button` (ends at line 517), before file end.

**Why this file:**
1. All button components live here
2. Already imported in the cascade layer
3. Consistent with sibling `.no-corner-btn*`, `.no-magnetic-corner-btn`, etc.
4. Allows reuse of shared color tokens and spacing variables

### 9. Conflict Analysis

**NO naming conflicts detected:**
- `.no-btn-char` is unique (only `.no-btn-bracket` exists, not `.no-btn-char`)
- Safe to add without affecting existing styles
- BEM pattern keeps scoping clear

**Shadow concerns:**
- `.shiny-cta` uses `::before` and `::after` pseudo-elements (don't conflict with child structure)
- `.no-corner-bracket` uses `<svg>` elements inside buttons (but `no-btn-char` can use own approach)
- Recommend using filter-based glow (like `.no-corner-bracket--shine`) for simplicity

### 10. Key Patterns to Follow

1. **Use `var(--*)` tokens** — no raw hex colors (already defined in abstract)
2. **Responsive spacing** — use `fluid(min, max)` or `var(--gutter-*)` 
3. **Transitions** — use `var(--transition-default)`, `var(--duration-*)`, `var(--ease-*)`
4. **Media queries** — use `@include mq()` mixin
5. **Accessibility** — always include `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` for animations
6. **Font style** — use `@include font("f-body-3")` for consistency (Geist Mono for UI buttons)

---

## Summary

**Where to add `no-btn-char` styles:**
- **File path:** `/c/Users/edn_y/renew_nineonelabs/resource/scss/components/_button.scss`
- **Starting line:** After line 517 (after `.no-prev-button`)
- **Import:** Already handled — no manual import needed

**Naming convention:** BEM with `no-` prefix
- Base class: `.no-btn-char`
- Modifiers: `.no-btn-char--[variant]`
- Elements: `.no-btn-char__[element]`

**Available for shimmering effect:**
- Existing shimmer patterns: `.shiny-cta` (gradient-based) and `.no-corner-bracket--shine` (filter-based)
- Duration: `var(--duration-default)` (0.4s) or `var(--duration-slow)` (0.6s) recommended
- Easing: `var(--ease-smooth)` for smooth, elegant feel
- Colors: Use `color-mix()` with `var(--clr-trigger-default)` for consistency

**No conflicts:** `no-btn-char` is a unique, available class name with room for modifiers.
